question: How was [TEPAH][ATA] synthesized: amounts of TEPA and ATA, solvent, stirring time and evaporation temperature?
expect: 0.0125 mol TEPA and 0.0125 mol ATA in 30 mL ethanol/water (4:1 v/v), stirred 12 h at room temperature, rotary evaporated at 60 C under vacuum (sec. 2.2)
rendered:
Document 1: "Amino-Functionalized Ionic Liquid Phase Change Absorbents for Efficient CO2 Capture"

The synthesis of [TEPAH][ATA] is described on page 2:

* 0.0125 mol of TEPA and 0.0125 mol of ATA were used.
* The solvent used was a 4:1 v/v ethanol/water solution.
* The mixture was magnetically stirred at room temperature for 12 hours.
* The mixture was then rotary evaporated at 60 °C under vacuum to remove excess solvent.
